notablePrerequisites: You control at least three additional creatures.
description:
Activate Naga Fleshcrafter by paying {2}{U} and exiling it from your graveyard, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing each other creature you control to become a copy of Biovisionary until end of turn.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary you control triggers. Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.
